description: This file defines an interface for mapping channel IDs to grain keys within the Orleans broadcasting system. It provides a contract for classes that implement the mapping logic, specifically the GetGrainKeyId method.

classes.name: IChannelIdMapper
classes.description: Interface for mapping a ChannelId to a GrainId.Key within Orleans broadcasting system.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Returns the GrainId.Key that corresponds to the specified ChannelId, using provided grain bindings.
